# codesbyshivam

codesbyshivam is Shivam Taneja's content and social brand. He makes honest, hands-on content for developers and builders: AI tools, developer life, building, and tech, with a little humour. That content goes out on X, YouTube, Instagram, Threads, and LinkedIn. Brands can see audience, platforms, and collaboration formats on the media kit.

His developer work and portfolio are on shivamtaneja.com, not this site. Dev humour also lives at theguyshetoldyouabout.com.
